about: La Tuque is a city in Mauricie, Quebec, on the Saint-Maurice River deep in the boreal interior north of Trois-Rivières. A vast municipal territory of forest, hydro reservoirs, and Atikamekw neighbouring communities surrounds a compact urban core built on forestry and river industry. About 11,000 people live in La Tuque’s urban area within a much larger city territory.
